messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE French line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
que tu me conduises là où tu l’as dit maintenant, pour que je voie la porte de saint Pierre et ceux que tu rends si affligés».

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------|--------| | che | subordinating conjunction introducing the content clause | **que** | “that” | OK | | tu | 2nd person singular pronoun, subject of *menare* | **tu** | “you” | OK | | mi | 1st person singular pronoun, direct object of *menare* | **me** | “me” | OK | | meni | verb “to lead”, 2nd sg. subjunctive | **conduises** | “lead” (subj.) | OK | | là | adverb of place “there” | **là** | “there” | OK | | dov' | adverb “where” (contraction of *dove*) | **où** | “where” | OK | | or | adverb of time “now” (archaic) | **maintenant** | “now” | OK | | dicesti | verb “to say”, 2nd sg. past indicative | **l’as dit** | “you have said it” | OK | | sì | adverb of result “so (that)” | **pour** (as part of *pour que*) | “so that” | OK | | ch'io | contraction of *che io* – introduces purpose clause, subject “I” | **que je** | “that I” | OK | | veggia | verb “to see”, 1st sg. present subjunctive | **voie** | “may see” | OK | | la | definite article, fem. singular | **la** | “the” | OK | | porta | noun “gate” | **porte** | “gate” | OK | | di | preposition “of” | **de** | “of” | OK | | san | abbreviation of *santo* “saint” | **saint** | “Saint” | WRONG (should be capitalised *Saint*) | | Pietro | proper noun “Peter” | **Pierre** | “Peter” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **et** | “and” | OK | | color | demonstrative plural pronoun “those” | **ceux** | “those” | OK | | cui | relative pronoun “whom/which” (object) | **que** | “whom” | OK | | tu | 2nd sg. pronoun, subject of *fai* | **tu** | “you” | OK | | fai | verb “to make/do”, 2nd sg. present indicative | **rends** | “make/ cause” | OK | | cotanto | degree adverb “so much, to such a degree” | **si** | “so” (intensifier) | OK | | mesti | adjective “afflicted, sad” (plural) | **affligés** | “afflicted” | OK |
